name: red-01-pipelined-behind-refusal-head
purpose: U040 RED against the HEAD bytes of server.cjs (commit a52f05e2, git blob d99e9bdf12d5f35d7389ec0f72dac6a3983fae19): the U038 audit probe as node:test files, in this process and in a separate node process, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/1.0 framing. Expect failures on assertions only: 10 of the audit's 15 refusal variants create a hub session, Node-own answers (417, no Host, parse error, 100 Continue) are not typed refusals. The 2 control tests that already hold pass.

notOk: in-process: an unknown Expect header is the typed 417 refusal, with Connection: close, and an upgrade behind it creates no session
in-process: Expect: 100-continue is decided by the handler: a refused request gets no 100 Continue, a valid read is answered without one
in-process: a request without Host is the typed 421 refusal in both framings, and an upgrade behind it creates no session
in-process: bytes Node cannot parse get the typed 400 refusal that closes the connection; nothing behind them upgrades
separate: an unknown Expect header is the typed 417 refusal, with Connection: close, and an upgrade behind it creates no session
separate: Expect: 100-continue is decided by the handler: a refused request gets no 100 Continue, a valid read is answered without one
separate: a request without Host is the typed 421 refusal in both framings, and an upgrade behind it creates no session
separate: bytes Node cannot parse get the typed 400 refusal that closes the connection; nothing behind them upgrades
a parse error is answered with the typed refusal that its cause maps to, then the connection is ended after the flush
a parse error on a socket that is gone, or that has already been answered, writes nothing and just destroys it
